heading: Art. 98. Misconduct as prisoner
lead: Any person subject to this chapter who, while in the hands of the enemy in time of war— shall be punished as a court-martial may direct.

tree.text: for the purpose of securing favorable treatment by his captors acts without proper authority in a manner contrary to law, custom, or regulation, to the detriment of others of whatever nationality held by the enemy as civilian or military prisoners; or
while in a position of authority over such persons maltreats them without justifiable cause;
